title: Mobile work starts before its required dependencies are available

regression.report: Shared read-only dependency mounts refuse the npm ci the review helper always runs

whatHappens: Mobile work starts before its required dependencies are available

observations.text: Feedback, 31 Oct 18:57 to 1 Nov 16:21 UTC: 19 reports from 2 agents, repeating on helper 0.1.133. Came with shared dependency mounts (#3188, #3192). No fix on main or open PR.

Historical setup reports include mobile lockfile rejection and missing workspace exports; those review paths shipped in PR 4131. New preparation reports use a release candidate rather than the delivered version. Hold; host repair PR 4156 is active.

fixes.text: Reuse or install review dependencies on shared mounts; fix corner opened 1 Nov
